title: melaleuca rariflora var. lonchophylla
intro: Melaleuca rariflora var. lonchophylla, commonly known as the Queensland teatree, is a plant species native to Australia. The health benefits of this plant include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Melaleuca rariflora var. lonchophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, making it a popular natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include its essential oils, particularly cineole, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
